kpis.netSub: {count, plural, one {{n} deal collected on} other {{n} deals collected on}} · Owner + Client
kpis.commissionSub: Each salesperson's rate on their share

sheet.afterApproval: Deals show here after the Office Manager approves them

split.note: For each deal: the collected commission splits in two halves (Buyer / Seller), and each half splits by the number of salespeople on that side. A salesperson's share is what counts toward their target, and their commission = their rate × their share.

achv.txSub: Deals with your name, collected on
achv.boardSub: {label} · ranked by what counted in target (each salesperson's share of the commission)

form.saved: Saved and waiting for the Office Manager's review
form.title: Log a deal
form.noLeads: No leads you can close on
form.fromDraft: From the Draft (pulled for no action)
form.seller: Seller: {name} (the unit's Agent · after Manar approves)
form.withMe: Anyone with you on the deal as Buyer?
form.hint: The company and source come from the client's details. The deal goes to the Office Manager first, and Finance logs the collections.

drawer.alarm: Alarm for the Office Manager: the deal was only logged at closing, so the salesperson may have worked on it without logging it. It counts as a Done Deal as usual, but not toward the salesperson's target.
drawer.cancelledNote: Deal cancelled: the revenue, Achievements and commissions were deducted automatically.
drawer.sellerWait: Seller: {names} (the Agent for {unit}) is waiting for Manar's approval before being added.
drawer.splitSub: Half to the Buyer and half to the Seller, each half split by the number of salespeople on that side
drawer.splitStarts: The split starts from the first collection.
drawer.sellerHalf: The Seller's half is shared out after Manar approves.
drawer.waitingReview: Waiting for the Office Manager's review.

noteForm.saved: Saved · it only changes the target
noteForm.title: note (Office Manager / Finance)
noteForm.notePh: e.g. count the target at a different amount

drawer.noCollection: No collections yet · Finance logs the collections
drawer.cancelled: Deal cancelled · the revenue, Achievements and commissions were deducted automatically

review.rejected: Deal sent back to sales with the reason
review.approved: Added to the Done Deals sheet · Marketing got an Alarm
review.title: Office Manager review
review.sub: You can edit any field before approving
review.approve: Approve and add to the sheet

collect.saved: Collection logged · the receipt voucher and journal entry were created
collect.revenue: Revenue type (the first collection books the whole commission)

claims.title: Claims and receipts
claims.sub: Request a claim for the client · after payment, a cash receipt

editCollection.title: Manual correction · {code}
editCollection.note: Only a user who may edit in Finance can make a manual correction, and the Audit Log keeps the old and the new amount.
editCollection.reasonPh: e.g. the amount was entered wrong
editCollection.saved: The correction is in the Audit Log
